meta.snr_definition: 10*log10(knock power / bed power) over the samples where a knock sounds
meta.knock_times: knock_times_ms are offsets from the first knock; the first knock sits at clip_onset_ms in the WAV
meta.classes: survivor = SOS, repeated 3-knock motif, 2-2 pairs or five_tap_reply (5 even taps, gap about 0.4-0.7 s, the reply to a rescuer's 'tap five times'; the repeat after a pause only fits the 8 s demo clips); debris = the same number of knocks at uniform random (Poisson conditioned on count) times over the same span. Both classes use the same knock pool and gain range, so only timing differs.
meta.bed: per trial in trials[].bed (see beds); rotor = synthetic debris impacts + settling grit + drone rotor hum, seeded [seed, 1]

beds.rotor: synthetic debris impacts + settling grit + drone rotor hum (hovering drone)
beds.rotor_off: synthetic debris impacts + settling grit + distant machinery, no rotor hum (landed node)

meta.bed_note: the first 400 trials keep the rotor bed; five_tap_reply trials and their debris matches use rotor_off, matched pairs share a bed so the bed can't separate the classes
